directions.title: Multimodal AI
directions.description: CLIP/SigLIP-style vision–language representations, multimodal fusion, instruction-tuned vision–language models, hard-negative sampling, and LoRA/QLoRA adaptation.

directions.title: NLP & retrieval
directions.description: Multilingual embeddings, bi-encoder retrieval and cross-encoder reranking, contrastive fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, calibration, and error analysis under imbalance or domain shift.

directions.title: Video & generative vision
directions.description: Optical-flow and feature-propagation temporal constraints, perceptual and flicker-aware evaluation, video transformers, and latent-diffusion approaches to controllable colorization.
